terminals.name: api
terminals.command: bash -lc 'PRE_DB="${DATABASE_URL:-}"; PRE_JWT="${JWT_SECRET:-}"; PRE_DEV_AUTH="${ALLOW_DEV_AUTH:-}"; set -a && source apps/api/.env && set +a; [ -n "$PRE_DB" ] && export DATABASE_URL="$PRE_DB"; [ -n "$PRE_JWT" ] && export JWT_SECRET="$PRE_JWT"; [ -n "$PRE_DEV_AUTH" ] && export ALLOW_DEV_AUTH="$PRE_DEV_AUTH"; pnpm --filter api start'
